sections.title: 程度診斷 + 基礎建立日
sections.markdown: 最終目標 TOEIC Listening & Reading 860+。建議投入 90～120 分鐘，先自己完成答案，再看解析。

sections.title: ① 今日核心單字 30 個
sections.markdown:
Office & Business 基礎高頻字

| 單字 | 詞性 | 中文 | 常見搭配 |
|---|---|---|---|
| applicant | n. | 申請者 | job applicant |
| application | n. | 申請；申請書 | submit an application |
| candidate | n. | 候選人 | qualified candidate |
| qualification | n. | 資格 | meet the qualifications |
| recruit | v. | 招募 | recruit employees |
| position | n. | 職位 | apply for a position |
| vacancy | n. | 職缺 | fill a vacancy |
| supervisor | n. | 主管 | contact a supervisor |
| colleague | n. | 同事 | former colleague |
| department | n. | 部門 | sales department |
| appointment | n. | 約會；預約 | make an appointment |
| schedule | n./v. | 行程；安排 | schedule a meeting |
| postpone | v. | 延後 | postpone a meeting |
| reschedule | v. | 重新安排 | reschedule an appointment |
| attend | v. | 出席 | attend a conference |
| participate | v. | 參加 | participate in |
| available | adj. | 有空的；可取得的 | available immediately |
| convenient | adj. | 方便的 | convenient location |
| deadline | n. | 截止期限 | meet a deadline |
| submit | v. | 提交 | submit a report |
| approve | v. | 核准 | approve a proposal |
| authorization | n. | 授權 | obtain authorization |
| purchase | n./v. | 購買 | purchase equipment |
| invoice | n. | 發票；請款單 | issue an invoice |
| receipt | n. | 收據 | keep a receipt |
| shipment | n. | 貨件；出貨 | track a shipment |
| delivery | n. | 配送 | delivery date |
| inventory | n. | 庫存 | check inventory |
| manufacturer | n. | 製造商 | local manufacturer |
| supplier | n. | 供應商 | reliable supplier |

### 今天特別記 5 組

> apply for a position → 應徵職位
> meet a deadline → 趕上期限
> submit an application → 提交申請
> participate in a conference → 參加會議
> track a shipment → 追蹤貨件

不要只背單字，要把搭配當成一整塊記。TOEIC 很常直接考這些搭配。

sections.title: ② 今日文法：詞性判斷
sections.markdown:
看到空格後迅速判斷需要名詞、動詞、形容詞或副詞，先不要翻譯整句。

### Q1

The manager gave a _____ explanation of the new policy.

(A) detail
(B) detailed
(C) details
(D) detailing

**Q1 → B**

a _____ explanation：explanation 是名詞，修飾名詞通常需要形容詞，故為 detailed explanation。

### Noun｜名詞

常見字尾：-tion, -ment, -ness, -ity

application
development
availability
agreement

### Adjective｜形容詞

常見字尾：-ive, -able, -ful, -ous

effective
available
successful
various

### Adverb｜副詞

常見字尾：-ly

quickly
carefully
recently
successfully

### Verb｜動詞

主詞 + 動詞

The company announced its new policy.

sections.title: ③ Listening 訓練
sections.markdown:
建立 Part 2 問句預測能力。聽到第一個疑問詞，就預測答案種類，不要急著翻譯每個單字。

### Q1

When will the new employees start working?

(A) Next Monday.
(B) At the main office.
(C) Five employees.

### Q2

Where should I leave these documents?

(A) About twenty pages.
(B) On Mr. Chen's desk.
(C) I read them yesterday.

### Q3

Why was the meeting postponed?

(A) Because the manager is away.
(B) In Conference Room B.
(C) At three o'clock.

### Q4

Who is responsible for ordering office supplies?

(A) The purchasing manager.
(B) Twice a month.
(C) About fifty dollars.

### Q5

How often do you check the inventory?

(A) In the warehouse.
(B) Every Friday.
(C) About twenty boxes.

### 答案與解析

**Q1 → A**

When → 時間。

**Q2 → B**

Where → 地點。

**Q3 → A**

Why → 原因。

**Q4 → A**

Who → 人。

**Q5 → B**

How often → 頻率。

後續會加入間接回答。

sections.title: ④ Reading 訓練
sections.markdown:
### Email

> To: All Employees
> From: Human Resources
> 
> The employee training session originally scheduled for September 5 has been postponed until September 12. The session will begin at 9:30 A.M. in Conference Room B.
> 
> Employees who have already registered do not need to register again. If you are unable to attend on the new date, please contact the Human Resources Department before September 8.

### Q1

Why was this email written?

(A) To announce a change in a training schedule
(B) To recruit new employees
(C) To introduce a new conference room
(D) To request employee applications

### Q2

When will the training take place?

(A) September 5
(B) September 8
(C) September 9
(D) September 12

### Q3

Who should contact Human Resources?

(A) New applicants
(B) Employees unable to attend
(C) Department supervisors
(D) Employees who already registered

### 答案與解析

**Q1 → A**

關鍵：postponed until September 12。

**Q2 → D**

新日期為 September 12。

**Q3 → B**

無法出席新日期的員工應聯絡人資；已報名者不必再次報名。

問題 → 關鍵字 → 回文章定位，不要先逐字翻譯。

sections.title: ⑤ 今日 TOEIC 仿真題
sections.markdown:
先自己作答。

### Q1

All employees must _____ their expense reports by Friday.

(A) submission
(B) submit
(C) submitted
(D) submitting

### Q2

The company's new website is extremely _____ and easy to navigate.

(A) convenience
(B) conveniently
(C) convenient
(D) conveniences

### Q3

Ms. Wang has extensive _____ in international marketing.

(A) experienced
(B) experience
(C) experiencing
(D) experientially

### Q4

The conference was _____ postponed because of severe weather.

(A) temporary
(B) temporarily
(C) temperature
(D) temporal

### Q5

Applicants should send their résumés _____ the Human Resources Department.

(A) at
(B) to
(C) by
(D) during

sections.title: ⑥ Day 1 小考
sections.markdown:
10 題程度紀錄。先記下答案，再看解析。

### Q1

The manager will _____ the proposal tomorrow.

(A) approval
(B) approve
(C) approved
(D) approving

### Q2

The new software significantly improves employee _____.

(A) productive
(B) production
(C) productivity
(D) productively

### Q3

Our company is looking for a highly _____ sales representative.

(A) qualify
(B) qualified
(C) qualification
(D) qualifyingly

### Q4

Please submit the application _____ Friday.

(A) by
(B) from
(C) during
(D) among

### Q5

The shipment is expected to _____ tomorrow morning.

(A) arrive
(B) arrival
(C) arriving
(D) arrived

### Q6

The conference room is currently _____.

(A) availability
(B) available
(C) availably
(D) availability's

### Q7

The meeting was _____ because the director was ill.

(A) participated
(B) purchased
(C) postponed
(D) submitted

### Q8

Employees must obtain _____ before purchasing new equipment.

(A) authorize
(B) authorized
(C) authorization
(D) authorizing

### Q9

Who should new employees contact about their schedules?

(A) Tomorrow morning.
(B) Their supervisor.
(C) In the main office.

### Q10

When will the package be delivered?

(A) By Friday afternoon.
(B) At the reception desk.
(C) The delivery driver.

sections.title: ⑦ 小考答案與解析
sections.markdown:
**Q1 → B**

will + 原形動詞：will approve。

**Q2 → C**

employee _____ 需要名詞；productivity = 生產力。

**Q3 → B**

空格修飾 sales representative，需要形容詞 qualified。

**Q4 → A**

by Friday 代表星期五以前／最晚星期五。

**Q5 → A**

to + 原形動詞：expected to arrive。

**Q6 → B**

be 動詞後可接形容詞：currently available。

**Q7 → C**

因為主管生病，所以 meeting was postponed。

**Q8 → C**

obtain + 名詞：obtain authorization。

**Q9 → B**

Who → 人：Their supervisor。

**Q10 → A**

When → 時間：By Friday afternoon。

sections.title: ⑧ 仿真題答案
sections.markdown:
**Q1 → B**

must + 原形動詞 submit。

**Q2 → C**

be 動詞後需要形容詞 convenient；extremely 修飾形容詞。

**Q3 → B**

extensive 修飾名詞 experience。

**Q4 → B**

副詞 temporarily 修飾 postponed。

**Q5 → B**

send something to someone：把某物寄給某人／部門。

1～4 題錯誤 → 複習詞性判斷。第 5 題錯誤 → 介系詞／搭配問題。

sections.title: ⑨ 今日錯題分類
sections.markdown:
| 代碼 | 問題 |
|---|---|
| V | Vocabulary 單字 |
| G | Grammar 文法 |
| L | Listening 沒聽懂 |
| M | Misread 看錯 |
| T | Time 時間不足 |
| TR | Trap 被陷阱選項騙 |

紀錄範例：Q2 → G → 不知道 improve 後面需要名詞 → productivity。不要只寫「Q2 錯」。

sections.title: ⑩ 今日作業與達標標準
sections.markdown:
30 個單字至少複習 2 次，特別是 applicant / qualification / postpone / deadline / submit / shipment / inventory / supplier。

五個搭配念三次：

> submit an application
> apply for a position
> meet a deadline
> postpone a meeting
> track a shipment

睡前重新做一次 10 題小考，目標 10 / 10。

| 正確題數 | 初步判斷 |
|---|---|
| 10 | 基礎很好，後續可以快速提高難度 |
| 8–9 | 有不錯的 TOEIC 基礎 |
| 6–7 | 中等，需要補文法與單字 |
| 4–5 | 基礎較弱，前 30 天會加強基本功 |
| 0–3 | 先建立核心英文能力 |

> TOEIC 不需要把每一句英文翻成中文，而是快速辨認「題目正在考什麼」。

Day 2：五大句型 S / V / O / C + Part 2 疑問句 + Part 5 詞性進階，累積第二批高頻單字。
